997-4871-8168.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying due to Draconic Visitor.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2104-2556-7370.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Mnemonic Wall.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Mnemonic Wall from exile to the battlefield.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

855-2122-7737.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Corpsejack Menace
Repeat.

3259-4053-7060-7604.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4053-7060-7604.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4053-7060-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

2082-3490-5256-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2082-3490-5256-7426.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat

240-4050-4359-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

5137-6287-7308.notablePrerequisites:
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness.
Morphling and Mona Lisa are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
5137-6287-7308.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Mona Lisa.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to its power.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Morphling.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

997-1417-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
997-1417-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Bridge from Below and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1170-1482-4211-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
1170-1482-4211-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1495-2445-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Branching Evolution.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

460-539-6479.description:
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

413-539-5649-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Blasting Station and Dragonback Assault trigger, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Blasting Station and Bladewing's Thrall trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bladewing's Thrall trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1742-3591-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1742-3591-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
1742-3591-5796-6282.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

488-2895-4211-4708-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Dark Sphere or Tormod's Crypt must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-2895-4211-4708-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

185-771-1980-2276-6229.notablePrerequisites:
Tetsuo has an Equipment attached to it with mana value 5 or greater.
Tetsuo does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Mystic Retrieval or Said must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
185-771-1980-2276-6229.description:
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Savage Beating without paying its mana cost, choosing its second mode.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Savage Beating.
Resolve both Savage Beatings, causing you to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Move to your first combat phase.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Mystic Retrieval without paying its mana cost, targeting Said.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Mystic Retrieval, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Mystic Retrievals, causing you to return Said and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Said without paying its mana cost, targeting Mystic Retrieval.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Said, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Saids, causing you to return Mystic Retrieval and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase, and repeat from step 1.

413-4871-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
When Shambling Ghast enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1809-5352.notablePrerequisites: There are four permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
1809-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Returned Pastcaller and of the four mana-producing permanents.
When the Returned Pastcaller tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Doppelgang and up to four other Spirit, instant or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5147-5370-5434.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Master of the Veil.
When Master of the Veil dies, Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Master of the Veil from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, then turning it face up.
Master of the Veil triggers, turning itself face down.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

549-1580-1785-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Soldevi Adnate.
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
549-1580-1785-2178.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}{B}.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Soldevi Adnate triggers, untapping Soldevi Adnate.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

703-2896-4089.description:
Cast Necromancy by paying {2}{B}.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then attaching Necromancy to Astral Dragon.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two token copies of Necromancy that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
When the Necromancy tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, with at least one trigger targeting Glasspool Mimic.
Resolve the first Necromancy trigger, returning Glasspool Mimic from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Astral Dragon, and not attaching Necromancy to Glasspool Mimic due to Necromancy being a creature.
The Necromancy Aura creature token is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to being an Aura that is unattached.
The Necromancy token leaves-the-battlefield ability triggers, as well as Glasspool Mimic's enters-the-battlefield ability.
Resolve the Necromancy trigger, causing you to sacrifce Glasspool Mimic.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, creating two token copies of Necromancy that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

413-4089-5011.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Glasspool Mimic.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2757-4151-4499.notablePrerequisites:
You control a basic land.
You control at least one additional creature.
2757-4151-4499.description:
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature you control, untapping the basic land.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Vishgraz.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

690-1496-1738.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
690-1496-1738.description:
Cast Serra Avatar by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}.
Serra Avatar enters the battlefield, triggering Verdant Sun's Avatar, causing you to gain life equal to Serra Avatar's toughness.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing target opponent whose lifetotal is less than or equal to Serra Avatar's toughness to lose life equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1765-2232-4050-4772.notablePrerequisites:
You have an Aura card in hand with mana value one or less.
You control an Aura with mana value one or less.
You have enough mana available to cast the Aura in hand.
1765-2232-4050-4772.description:
Cast an Aura with mana value one or less by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature you control.
The Aura enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Chishiro.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return any other Aura with mana value one or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chishiro trigger, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1308-1812-1923-2034.description:
Cast Summon the School for {3}{W}, creating four Merfolk creature tokens.
Activate Summon the School by tapping four untapped Merfolk, returning it to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Merfolk token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 3 an additional two times.
Activate Prismite for {2}, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2843-3175-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

802-864-914-5257.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control five or more artifacts and/or enchantments.
802-864-914-5257.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist for {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, its own ETB triggers and Riku of Two Reflections triggers.
Stack the triggers such that Dockside Extortionist's trigger resolves first, creating 5 Treasure tokens.
Pay for the Riku of Two Reflections trigger using 2 Treasures, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist that creates another 5 Treasure tokens.
Cast Snap using two of your 8 Treasures, returning Dockside Extortionist to your hand and untapping two lands, leaving you with 6 Treasure tokens and two untapped lands.
Cast Eternal Witness with an untapped land and two Treasure tokens, leaving an untapped land and four Treasure tokens.
When it enters the battlefield, Eternal Witness and Riku of Two Reflections trigger.
Stack the triggers such that Eternal Witness resolves first, returning Snap to your hand.
Before the Riku trigger resolves, cast Snap using an untapped land and a Treasure, returning Dockside Extortionist to your hand and leaving you with 2 untapped lands and 3 Treasure tokens.
Pay for the Riku of Two Reflectons trigger with 2 Treasure tokens, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness that returns Snap to your hand on ETB.
You are now back where you started, but with an extra Treasure token, an Eternal Witness token, and a Dockside Extortionist token, and with 2 untapped lands instead of {1}{R}.
Repeat for infinite Treasure tokens and creature tokens.
